goals.text: Fix missing pytest marks: a class inheriting from two base classes each with a distinct @pytest.mark should collect both inherited markers instead of only the first per MRO.
Fix the TypeError introduced by MRO-merging in get_unpacked_marks by making the dedup key hashable, since Mark/kwargs are unhashable.

facts.text: A class inheriting from two base classes Foo and Bar loses one marker because pytestmark is resolved via MRO (last wins).
get_unpacked_marks() reads obj.pytestmark via getattr (follows MRO) and populates own_markers; Mark is unhashable (kwargs is a dict).
Real pytest collection of TestDings(Foo, Bar) exposed only the foo mark; -m bar selected nothing, confirming the bug.
Existing tests test_mark_decorator_baseclasses_merged and test_mark_decorator_subclass_does_not_propagate_to_base must not be broken by the fix.

changedPaths.text: Proposed to modify get_unpacked_marks() in src/_pytest/mark/structures.py to merge marks across the object's MRO with a hashable dedup key. The edit was applied to the in-memory workspace file but never saved to disk.

Assertion-based reproduction (TestDings(Foo, Bar) with foo/bar marks) failed because TestDings.pytestmark returned only ['foo']; the bar assertion failed.
